how_to_apply: Prepare your application along with a Cover Letter and an updated CV.
Gather softcopies of certificates and documents including age proof, degree certificates, mark sheets, and relevant experience or research credentials.
Send the complete application package through email to Dr. Indrajit Saha at [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches on or before the last date, which is 27/10/2026.
important_instructions: The position is purely temporary and project-based and is co-terminus with the project. Mere possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure that the candidate would be called for Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of merit, relevant experience, and the need of the project. Applicants in employment (private, government, or any other organization) are required to submit a “No Objection Certificate” from the employer at the time of interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The engagement will be subject to the applicable rules and regulations of NITTTR Kolkata.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment position advertised by NITTTR Kolkata?
faq.answer: NITTTR Kolkata has advertised for the post of Research Staff (Project Scientist-level Research Position) under an AICTE RPS 2025 sponsored project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NITTTR Kolkata Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 27/10/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly salary for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 32,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for NITTTR Kolkata Project Scientist?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech./M.Sc./MCA/MS or equivalent in Computer Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Information Technology, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or allied areas with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates should be preferably below 32 years of age as on 27/10/2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the NITTTR Kolkata Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: Interested candidates should send their application, cover letter, updated CV, and softcopies of certificates through email to Dr. Indrajit Saha at [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a written test followed by an interview for final selection.

faq.question: Q8. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled to be held on 13/11/2026, following the notification of shortlisted candidates on 06/11/2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.
